caribbean.headline: Small Craft Advisory for Roatan, Choppy Seas Expected
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained ENE winds near 24 kt with 6.2 ft seas and a 9 s ENE swell, producing conditions that meet Small Craft Advisory criteria for the western Caribbean port. I expect intermittent heavy showers (50% rain probability) and advise small-boat operators to secure gear, while Martinique will see lighter easterly winds near 11 kt.

mediterranean.headline: NE Swell Brings 6.5 ft Seas to Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northeast swells with seas to 6.5 ft, a dominant NE swell period of 6 s, and sustained winds up to 22 kt with less than 10% rain probability. I note Cadiz is much calmer with winds near 11 kt and minimal seas, and I advise mariners to exercise caution around Mykonos where winds are at Small Craft Advisory thresholds.
